cards.name: Erika's Oddish
cards.flavorText: When it is woken by moonlight, it wanders about. But during the day, it stays still underground.

cards.name: Erika's Gloom
cards.flavorText: It secretes a sticky, drool-like nectar. Though sweet, it smells too repulsive to get very close.

cards.name: Erika's Bellsprout
cards.flavorText: Even though its body is extremely skinny, it is blindingly fast when catching its prey.

cards.name: Erika's Weepinbell
cards.flavorText: It spits out Poison Powder to immobilize the enemy and then finishes it with a spray of Acid.

cards.name: Erika's Tangela
cards.flavorText: Hidden beneath a tangle of vines that grows nonstop even if the vines are torn off, this Pokémon’s true appearance remains a mystery.

cards.name: Chikorita
cards.flavorText: A sweet aroma gently wafts from the leaf on its head. It is docile and loves to soak up sun rays.

cards.name: Wurmple
cards.flavorText: It loves to eat leaves. If it is attacked by a Starly, it will defend itself with its spiked rear.

cards.name: Silcoon
cards.flavorText: It wraps silk around the branches of a tree. It drinks rainwater on its silk while awaiting evolution.

cards.name: Beautifly
cards.flavorText: Vibrantly patterned wings are its prominent feature. It sucks sweet flower nectar with its long mouth.

cards.name: Cascoon
cards.flavorText: Its body, which is made of soft silk, hardens over time. When cracks appear, evolution is near.

cards.name: Dustox
cards.flavorText: A nocturnal Pokémon. Drawn by streetlights, they messily eat the leaves of trees lining boulevards.

cards.name: Budew
cards.flavorText: The pollen it releases contains poison. If this Pokémon is raised on clean water, the poison’s toxicity is increased.

cards.name: Grubbin
cards.flavorText: It spits sticky threads and winds them around branches, then swings nimbly from tree to tree in a pendulum-like motion.

cards.name: Team Rocket's Tarountula
cards.flavorText: The ball of threads wrapped around its body is elastic enough to deflect the scythes of Scyther, this Pokémon’s natural enemy.

cards.name: Team Rocket's Spidops
cards.flavorText: It clings to branches and ceilings using its threads and moves without a sound. It takes out its prey before the prey even notices it.

cards.name: Charmander
cards.flavorText: The flame on its tail indicates Charmander’s life force. If it is healthy, the flame burns brightly.

cards.name: Charmeleon
cards.flavorText: It lashes about with its tail to knock down its foe. It then tears up the fallen opponent with sharp claws.

cards.name: Ethan's Slugma
cards.flavorText: Its lava body can cool and chip away at times, but a magma bath will heal it right up.

cards.name: Ethan's Magcargo
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon lives near the craters of volcanoes. It stores fire energy in its shell of cooled and hardened magma.

cards.name: Entei
cards.flavorText: A Pokémon that races across the land. It is said that one is born every time a new volcano appears.

cards.name: Numel
cards.flavorText: The magma in its body reaches 2,200 degrees Fahrenheit. Its hump gets smaller when it uses Fire-type moves.

cards.name: Camerupt
cards.flavorText: The volcanoes on its back have a major eruption every 10 years--or whenever it becomes really angry.

cards.name: Tepig
cards.flavorText: It can deftly dodge its foe’s attacks while shooting fireballs from its nose. It roasts berries before it eats them.

cards.name: Pignite
cards.flavorText: The more it eats, the more fuel it has to make the fire in its stomach stronger. This fills it with even more power.

cards.name: N's Darumaka
cards.flavorText: This popular symbol of good fortune will never fall over in its sleep, no matter how it’s pushed or pulled.

cards.name: N's Darmanitan
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon’s power level rises along with the temperature of its fire, which can reach 2,500 degrees Fahrenheit.

cards.name: Salandit
cards.flavorText: Only female Salandit can produce gas laden with pheromones. Males entranced by this gas will do whatever the females tell them.

cards.name: Salazzle
cards.flavorText: When two Salazzle meet, they will use their pheromone gas to fight over the males in each other’s group.

cards.name: Scorbunny
cards.flavorText: Fire energy gathers in the pads of its feet, raising their temperature. Once hot, Scorbunny’s footpads can deal heavy damage to opponents.

cards.name: Raboot
cards.flavorText: While it prides itself on its varied kicking moves, it can also deliver powerful headbutts once its flames have heated up its forehead.

cards.name: Psyduck
cards.flavorText: It is constantly wracked by a headache. When the headache turns intense, it begins using mysterious powers.

cards.name: Golduck
cards.flavorText: When it swims at full speed using its long, webbed limbs, its forehead somehow begins to glow.

cards.name: Totodile
cards.flavorText: It is small but rough and tough. It won't hesitate to take a bite out of anything that moves.

cards.name: Croconaw
cards.flavorText: If it loses a fang, a new one grows back in its place. There are always 48 fangs lining its mouth.

cards.name: Sneasel
cards.flavorText: This is a smart and sneaky Pokémon. A pair may work together to steal eggs by having one lure the parents away.

cards.name: Weavile
cards.flavorText: They travel in groups of four or five, leaving signs for one another on trees and rocks. They bring down their prey with coordinated attacks.

cards.name: Snorunt
cards.flavorText: In some snowy lands, certain folklore says a house will prosper if a Snorunt lives there.

cards.name: N's Vanillite
cards.flavorText: The temperature of their breath is -58 degrees Fahrenheit. They create snow crystals and make snow fall in the areas around them.

cards.name: N's Vanillish
cards.flavorText: They cool down the surrounding air and create ice particles, which they use to freeze their foes.

cards.name: Snom
cards.flavorText: Within its internal organs, Snom amplifies the frigid air it gets from eating snow and then uses this amplified air to create icicle-like spikes.

cards.name: Frosmoth
cards.flavorText: It causes blizzards as it flies around with its huge, chill-emanating wings. Clean meltwater is its favorite thing to drink.

cards.name: Glastrier
cards.flavorText: Glastrier emits intense cold from its hooves. It’s also a belligerent Pokémon—anything it wants, it takes by force.

cards.name: Raichu
cards.flavorText: When its electricity builds, its muscles are stimulated, and it becomes more aggressive than usual.

cards.name: Tynamo
cards.flavorText: While one alone doesn’t have much power, a chain of many Tynamo can be as powerful as lightning.

cards.name: Eelektrik
cards.flavorText: They coil around foes and shock them with electricity-generating organs that seem simply to be circular patterns.

cards.name: Stunfisk
cards.flavorText: It conceals itself in the mud of the seashore. Then it waits. When prey touch it, it delivers a jolt of electricity.

cards.name: Helioptile
cards.flavorText: The frills on either side of its head have cells that generate electricity when exposed to sunlight.

cards.name: Heliolisk
cards.flavorText: They flare their frills and generate energy. A single Heliolisk can generate sufficient electricity to power a skyscraper.

cards.name: Charjabug
cards.flavorText: While its durable shell protects it from attacks, Charjabug strikes at enemies with jolts of electricity discharged from the tips of its jaws.

cards.name: Vikavolt
cards.flavorText: When carrying a Charjabug, Vikavolt can receive electricity from it and then rapidly fire powerful electromagnetic beams from its large jaws.

cards.name: Tapu Koko
cards.flavorText: Although it’s called a guardian deity, if a person or Pokémon puts it in a bad mood, it will become a malevolent deity and attack.

cards.name: Iono's Tadbulb
cards.flavorText: Tadbulb shakes its tail to generate electricity. If it senses danger, it will make its head blink on and off to alert its allies.

cards.name: Iono's Wattrel
cards.flavorText: When its wings catch the wind, the bones within produce electricity. This Pokémon dives into the ocean, catching prey by electrocuting them.

cards.name: Iono's Kilowattrel
cards.flavorText: Kilowattrel inflates its throat sac to amplify its electricity. By riding the wind, this Pokémon can fly over 430 miles in a day.

cards.name: Clefairy
cards.flavorText: On nights with a full moon, they gather together and dance. The surrounding area is enveloped in an abnormal magnetic field.

cards.name: Clefable
cards.flavorText: It has an acute sense of hearing. It can easily hear a pin being dropped nearly 1,100 yards away.

cards.name: Team Rocket's Exeggcute
cards.flavorText: Using telepathy only fellow Exeggcute can pick up on, they always form a cluster of six.

cards.name: Team Rocket's Exeggutor
cards.flavorText: It is said that on rare occasions, one of its heads will drop off and continue on as an Exeggcute.

cards.name: Togepi
cards.flavorText: The shell seems to be filled with joy. It is said that it will share good luck when treated kindly.

cards.name: Togetic
cards.flavorText: They say that it will appear before kindhearted, caring people and shower them with happiness.

cards.name: Togekiss
cards.flavorText: These Pokémon are never seen anywhere near conflict or turmoil. In recent times, they’ve hardly been seen at all.

cards.name: Marill
cards.flavorText: The oil-filled tail functions as a buoy, so it’s fine even in rivers with strong currents.

cards.name: Misdreavus
cards.flavorText: It loves to bite and yank people's hair from behind without warning, just to see their shocked reactions.

cards.name: Mismagius
cards.flavorText: Its cries sound like incantations to torment the foe. It appears where you least expect it.

cards.name: Ralts
cards.flavorText: The horns on its head provide a strong power that enables it to sense people’s emotions.

cards.name: Kirlia
cards.flavorText: It has a psychic power that enables it to distort the space around it and see into the future.

cards.name: Shuppet
cards.flavorText: It loves to feed on feelings like envy and malice. Its upright horn catches the emotions of people.

cards.name: Banette
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon developed from an abandoned doll that amassed a grudge. It is seen in dark alleys.

cards.name: Rotom
cards.flavorText: Research continues on this Pokémon, which could be the power source of a unique motor.

cards.name: Slurpuff
cards.flavorText: It can distinguish the faintest of scents. It puts its sensitive sense of smell to use by helping pastry chefs in their work.

cards.name: Hop's Phantump
cards.flavorText: According to old tales, these Pokémon are stumps possessed by the spirits of children who died while lost in the forest.

cards.name: Hop's Trevenant
cards.flavorText: Using its roots as a nervous system, it controls the trees in the forest. It’s kind to the Pokémon that reside in its body.

cards.name: Team Rocket's Mimikyu
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon lives in dark places untouched by sunlight. When it appears before humans, it hides itself under a cloth that resembles a Pikachu.

cards.name: Spectrier
cards.flavorText: It probes its surroundings with all its senses save one—it doesn’t use its sense of sight. Spectrier’s kicks are said to separate soul from body.

cards.name: Munkidori
cards.flavorText: Munkidori keeps itself somewhere safe while it toys with its foes, using psychokinesis to induce intense dizziness.

cards.name: Team Rocket's Diglett
cards.flavorText: Its skin is very thin. If it is exposed to light, its blood heats up, causing it to grow weak.

cards.name: Team Rocket's Dugtrio
cards.flavorText: In battle, it digs through the ground and strikes the unsuspecting foe from an unexpected direction.

cards.name: Hitmontop
cards.flavorText: It spins on its horn while dealing out elegant kicks. Its horn grows continuously through its lifetime.

cards.name: Lunatone
cards.flavorText: It was discovered at the site of a meteor strike 40 years ago. Its stare can lull its foes to sleep.

cards.name: Solrock
cards.flavorText: Solar energy is the source of its power, so it is strong during the daytime. When it spins, its body shines.

cards.name: Groudon
cards.flavorText: Said to have expanded the lands by evaporating water with raging heat. It battled titanically with Kyogre.

cards.name: Cynthia's Gible
cards.flavorText: It skulks in caves, and when prey or an enemy passes by, it leaps out and chomps them. The force of its attack sometimes chips its teeth.

cards.name: Cynthia's Gabite
cards.flavorText: In rare cases, it molts and sheds its scales. Medicine containing its scales as an ingredient will make a weary body feel invigorated.

cards.name: Riolu
cards.flavorText: They communicate with one another using their auras. They are able to run all through the night.

cards.name: Pancham
cards.flavorText: It does its level best to glare and pull a scary face, but it can’t help grinning if anyone pats its head.

cards.name: Rolycoly
cards.flavorText: Chunks of the surface of this Pokémon’s body that have grown old and flaked off have long been used for fuel as an alternative to coal.

cards.name: Carkol
cards.flavorText: Due to the coal tar created inside it, the heap of coal on Carkol’s back never falls apart, even when the Pokémon rolls around at high speeds.

cards.name: Coalossal
cards.flavorText: It’s gentle usually but fearsome when angered. With a body that burns at over 2,700 degrees Fahrenheit, it crushes foes and turns them to ash.

cards.name: Okidogi
cards.flavorText: Okidogi is a ruffian with a short temper. It can pulverize anything by swinging around the chain on its neck.

cards.name: Gastly
cards.flavorText: It wraps its opponent in its gas-like body, slowly weakening its prey by poisoning it through the skin.

cards.name: Haunter
cards.flavorText: It likes to lurk in the dark and tap shoulders with a gaseous hand. Its touch causes endless shuddering.

cards.name: Team Rocket's Murkrow
cards.flavorText: Feared and loathed by many, it is believed to bring misfortune to all those who see it at night.

cards.name: Team Rocket's Honchkrow
cards.flavorText: A single cry from this nocturnal Pokémon, and more than 100 of its Murkrow cronies will assemble.

cards.name: Poochyena
cards.flavorText: A Pokémon with a persistent nature, it chases its chosen prey until the prey becomes exhausted.

cards.name: Mightyena
cards.flavorText: It will always obey the commands of a skilled Trainer. Its behavior arises from its living in packs in ancient times.

cards.name: Galarian Zigzagoon
cards.flavorText: Its restlessness has it constantly running around. If it sees another Pokémon, it will purposely run into them in order to start a fight.

cards.name: Galarian Linoone
cards.flavorText: It uses its long tongue to taunt opponents. Once the opposition is enraged, this Pokémon hurls itself at the opponent, tackling them forcefully.

cards.name: Galarian Obstagoon
cards.flavorText: Its voice is staggering in volume. Obstagoon has a tendency to take on a threatening posture and shout—this move is known as Obstruct.

cards.name: Cynthia's Spiritomb
cards.flavorText: Its constant mischief and misdeeds resulted in it being bound to an Odd Keystone by a mysterious spell.

cards.name: Scraggy
cards.flavorText: Its skin has a rubbery elasticity, so it can reduce damage by defensively pulling its skin up to its neck.

cards.name: N's Zorua
cards.flavorText: It changes into the forms of others to surprise them. Apparently, it often transforms into a silent child.

cards.name: Vullaby
cards.flavorText: Its healthy appetite leads to visible growth spurts. It often has to replace the bones it wears as its size increases.

cards.name: Hoopa
cards.flavorText: This troublemaker sends anything and everything to faraway places using its loop, which can warp space.

cards.name: Pecharunt
cards.flavorText: Its peach-shaped shell serves as storage for a potent poison. It makes poisonous mochi and serves them to people and Pokémon.

cards.name: Mawile
cards.flavorText: Attached to its head is a huge set of jaws formed by horns. It can chew through iron beams.

cards.name: Pawniard
cards.flavorText: Any chips in its blades would prove fatal for it. After each battle, it diligently maintains its blades using its favorite sharpening stone.

cards.name: Bisharp
cards.flavorText: Bisharp mercilessly cuts its opponents to pieces with the sharp blades covering its body. It will do anything to win.

cards.name: Kingambit
cards.flavorText: Though it commands a massive army in battle, it’s not skilled at devising complex strategies. It just uses brute strength to keep pushing.

cards.name: Dratini
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon is full of life energy. It continually sheds its skin and grows steadily larger.

cards.name: Dragonair
cards.flavorText: Its crystalline orbs appear to give this Pokémon the power to freely control the weather.

cards.name: Rayquaza
cards.flavorText: It lives in the ozone layer far above the clouds and cannot be seen from the ground.

cards.name: N's Reshiram
cards.flavorText: According to myth, if people ignore truth and let themselves become consumed by greed, Reshiram will arrive to burn their kingdoms down.

cards.name: N's Zekrom
cards.flavorText: When the interior part of its tail spins like a motor, Zekrom can generate many bolts of lightning to blast its surroundings.

cards.name: Noibat
cards.flavorText: Even a robust wrestler will become dizzy and unable to stand when exposed to its 200,000-hertz ultrasonic waves.

cards.name: Noivern
cards.flavorText: They fly around on moonless nights and attack careless prey. Nothing can beat them in a battle in the dark.

cards.name: Dreepy
cards.flavorText: It has a habit of biting at Clauncher even though it doesn’t feed on them. This is said to be vestigial behavior from when Dreepy was alive.

cards.name: Drakloak
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon stores up energy in its lungs, then shoots it out. It takes care of Dreepy and battles alongside them until they’re all grown up.

cards.name: Team Rocket's Meowth
cards.flavorText: All it does is sleep during the daytime. At night, it patrols its territory with its eyes aglow.

cards.name: Larry's Dunsparce
cards.flavorText: If spotted, it escapes by burrowing with its tail. It can float just slightly using its wings.

cards.name: Skitty
cards.flavorText: It can’t stop itself from chasing moving things, and it runs in a circle, chasing its own tail.

cards.name: Delcatty
cards.flavorText: It dislikes dirty places. It often searches for a comfortable place in which to groom itself.

cards.name: Larry's Starly
cards.flavorText: Because they are weak individually, they form groups. However, they bicker if the group grows too big.

cards.name: Larry's Staravia
cards.flavorText: They maintain huge flocks, although fierce scuffles break out between various flocks.

cards.name: Larry's Staraptor
cards.flavorText: It never stops attacking even if it is injured. It fusses over the shape of its comb.

cards.name: Fan Rotom
cards.flavorText: There are several appliances that Rotom can inspirit, but the first one to be developed was the electric fan.

cards.name: Larry's Rufflet
cards.flavorText: With its sharp claws, this Pokémon pierces its prey, and then it pecks at them. Although it also consumes berries, it’s a carnivore at heart.

cards.name: Larry's Braviary
cards.flavorText: For the sake of its friends, this brave warrior of the sky will not stop battling, even if injured.

cards.name: Larry's Komala
cards.flavorText: A potent anesthetic can be made by diluting Komala’s drool. This anesthetic was used for surgeries in the past.

cards.name: Drampa
cards.flavorText: It has a compassionate personality, but if it is angered, it completely destroys its surroundings with its intense breath.

cards.name: Hop's Cramorant
cards.flavorText: Cramorant instinctively swallow everything whole. They’re at their most formidable when they’re struggling to swallow overly large prey.

cards.name: Terapagos
cards.flavorText: The shell is made of crystallized Terastal energy. When struck by a move, this shell absorbs the move’s energy and transfers it to Terapagos.

cards.name: Erika's Tangela
cards.flavorText: Hidden beneath a tangle of vines that grows nonstop even if the vines are torn off, this Pokémon’s true appearance remains a mystery.
